core_requests: providers/quota (P334): a setting-driven override of a provider quota block for a recorded paid plan, and per-endpoint windows (crowdsec monthly plan above Community 120; abuseipdb Basic/Premium daily limits and check-block budgets)
config/WP02: add V3LUM_VT_KEY as an env alias of key virustotal (the core-seeded virustotal fragment has no keys block; extensions cannot add keys)

http (HttpClient._spend_rate_wait): an opt-out so a provider can defer (QUOTA) instead of waiting one provider slot in the worker; virustotal carries its own pacer meanwhile (P158 c3 'the scan never waits on VT')
report/exports (P303): honour provider x_redistribution and the export_restriction attribute (export verdict, link and source only for crowdsec/abuseipdb/virustotal/hybrid_analysis)
models: Pivot tags (e.g. hostile) for the P376 guard; sandbox-contacted hosts use note 'hostile: ...' until then
datasets: a dataset-manager hook to build and persist derived indexes at 'v3lum data update' (LOLDrivers slim projection, ~1.5 MB > ctx.state cap)
keys wizard (WP25/P379): never offer the public VirusTotal key under the corporate profile (A15/P158 c6)
doctor/health (P337): approve GET /v2/info as crowdsec_cti health check instead of spending a monthly lookup on a probe IP
orgprofile: an ownership notion for file hashes so a vulnerable-driver hit on an org asset can be HIGH without the subject_roles workaround
optional: list 'crowdsec' in config.KNOWN_KEYS (currently registered via the provider fragment keys block)
notes: All five proposals delivered as contract-v2 modules; no existing file modified (only batch-owned new files).
